svg.title: BCJRFormer microarchitecture
svg.desc: Five sequential memory-backed stages, actual core controller links, shared numerical engines, thirteen memory clients, and logical banks. No concurrent inter-stage pipeline is implied.

g.text: One frame at a time · memory-backed execution · shared numerical engines · provisional fixed-point formats
Load parameters → load frame → dispatch stages → stream outputs → report status
Dashed cyan arrows show tensor order through memory; they are not direct inter-stage streaming wires.
Each engine below exists once in bcjrformer_core
Linear clients: embedding, QKV, out projection, FFN, final
Core / stage controllers + their numerical services · request / response arbitration · bank / address checks
PARAM: embedding · position P · read E
K encoder layer regions · final weight / bias
FEATURE · MASK · X · U · Q · KEY · VALUE · Z · ATTN_OUT
TOKEN · FFN_HIDDEN (F22) · VECTOR · SCORE · EXP · PROB · LOGIT · OUTPUT
Bank names denote logical storage; physical SRAM mapping remains open
Clock and reset reach every physical module. Port bundles are SystemVerilog interfaces; arrows summarize ready/valid channels.
Stage memory trunks include descendant controllers. EXP, GELU, RECIP and RSQRT exchange operands only; they have no memory port.
